posts.text: Injective perps liquidity looks deeper this session. Perps books are awake.
Orderbook depth on the perp venue I follow is tighter. Liquidity is sitting closer.
Book depth is the perp signal I trust. Liquidity tells me more than headlines.
Maker programs are doing more for liquidity than announcements. Perps feel it.
Liquidity providers are the quiet half of the orderbook. Depth is the receipt.
Tighter spreads show up when makers stay on the perp book. Liquidity follows makers.
Routing through the orderbook keeps perp liquidity honest. Depth over slogans.
More perp venues, same matching engine, deeper liquidity. Orderbook still the source.
